summary: Design: sketch editing moves from the relations panel to the canvas, a thin bar and the feature tree. While a sketch is edited, a thin bar centred across the top of the view shows its name, its constraint status, a count of constraint issues that opens the list of conflicting, redundant or unmet relations and of curves a Symmetric solve shrank, the Show dimensions and Show relations toggles, a slot for view modes, Finish and, for a sketch a solid uses, Cancel sketch edits. In Select, a selection of points and edges shows a row of relation icons beside it, never over it and, where it can, clear of dimension labels, relation marks and floating panels, built from the relation registry's offers for that selection without a solve: available relations press to apply, applied ones show pressed and press to remove the relations they name, and blocked ones are disabled and say why. Every press goes through the same native check as any relation edit, so a conflicting relation is refused, the part keeps its version and the bar counts the conflict. The row covers selections of several elements, Fix for a whole edge, Symmetric, Symmetric centers for two circles and a line or axis, Concentric and Tangent, and ends with Dimension the selection, which starts the Dimension tool on the picks. It hides while drawing, dragging or waiting for an edit. Canvas marks and dimensions are the primary relation list: hover highlights, click selects, Delete removes, double-click edits a value at its dimension and right-click opens the actions. The sketch's relations are listed under it in the feature tree, with name, operands, value and state, scrolled virtually so hundreds of relations open like a few; a row selects its mark or dimension and highlights its geometry, Delete removes it and a double-click or Enter opens its value editor. Diagnostics reach the bar and the tree rows through one adapter, cadSketchIssuesStandInForD1, which the D1 diagnostics work replaces. Values are edited at the dimension, keeping expressions, units, parameters, reference flips, validation and pending precision. Status messages move to the top right while the bar shows. The relations panel, its angle sector chooser and its tests are removed; their behaviour is covered by the new components' tests.
warning: Not breaking for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, controller output, CAD files or agent tools. People who used the relations panel find its commands in the selection icon row, the Dimension tool, the value editor at each dimension, the feature tree's relations list and the thin bar; Fix X and Fix Y become a dimension from the H or V axis. While a sketch is open, status messages show at the top right instead of the top centre.

checklist.schema: No schema change. The sketch graph, relation kinds, CAD document and save envelope, UPID, post schema and engine API are unchanged. Saved sketches open and save byte for byte as before.
checklist.events: No execution event, input-version or cancellation change. Relation presses use the existing applySketchEdits and submitEdit path with the same native judge, draft rules and Undo steps as the panel's Apply; a refusal keeps the version and reports through the same feedback, now shown in the bar's issue list and the tree rows.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. WebMCP tools, their arguments, results and discovery are unchanged: 49 CAD tools, 51,178 of 51,200 discovery bytes, the same as 0.0.794. The public agent guide changes only in two sentences that describe the human interface.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Nothing is migrated or rewritten.
checklist.verification: Full Vitest: 622 files, 7,175 tests pass. Production build, lint with the precision literal check, ui:check and icons:check pass, and the icon integration audit is regenerated. WebMCP discovery is 51,178 bytes, unchanged. Relation, dimension, panel and area specs pass, each run alone with two workers. Mutations caught: an icon row omitting the first available offer fails 4 tests, Delete on a selected mark doing nothing fails 22, a tree row not selecting its mark fails 2, and a diagnostic not reaching the bar fails 3. Hover over a 300-relation sketch at 4x CPU throttle, 150 pointer moves, median of 10 runs against the 0.0.794 build alternately: delay to handle a move 20.9 ms against 21.0 ms, script time 546 ms against 538 ms, style and layout time the same. Opening that sketch: canvas shown in a median 519 ms against 481 ms, and analysed in 549 ms against 514 ms.

publicNotes.summary: Sketch editing uses canvas marks, a selection icon row and a thin bar across the top.
changes: While a sketch is open, a thin bar across the top shows its name and status, a count of constraint issues that lists them, the Show dimensions and Show relations toggles, Finish and, for a sketch a solid uses, Cancel sketch edits.

Select points and edges to see a row of relation icons beside them, placed clear of the selection and, where it can, of dimension labels and marks. Press an icon to add its relation, or a pressed icon to remove it. An icon that cannot apply is disabled and says why, and Dimension the selection starts a dimension on the picks.
Two circles with a line or an axis offer Symmetric centers beside Symmetric, which mirrors only their centers so each radius keeps its own dimension.

Relation marks and dimensions on the canvas act as the relation list: hover highlights, click selects, Delete removes, double-click edits a value where the dimension is drawn, and right-click opens the actions.
The sketch's relations are listed under it in the feature tree, with their values and any conflicts. A row selects its mark, Delete removes it, and long lists scroll smoothly.
To hold one coordinate of a point, dimension it from the H or V axis.
Status messages show at the top right while a sketch is open, so they never cover the bar.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions, controller output, CAD files and agent tools are unchanged.
